capabilities: Control the Spotify desktop app with play/pause, previous and next commands
Display a mini player or fullscreen cover with three themes and an e-ink dither filter
Search tracks via Deezer and play results or paste a Spotify track link
Keep a list of the last 50 played tracks for one-click replay
Expose panel and playback commands for hotkey assignment
extras: Works with Spotify Free; no account login or API key needed because search uses Deezer's public API and playback goes through local D-Bus. Includes a documented fix for Flatpak-installed Obsidian (a dbus-send permission command) and states there is no telemetry. Not affiliated with Spotify AB.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see or control desktop music playback without leaving the window.

relations.evidence: the plugin runs dbus-send to read the current track and send play/pause, next, previous
Search results come from Deezer's public catalog (Spotify's own search API requires a Premium account)

summary: Linux panel that controls the Spotify desktop app over MPRIS, showing the current track with a mini or fullscreen player, plus track search and recent-track replay.
